method: Actual upstream and plugin ArchiveScene sources compiled with the same esbuild settings; both use installed Three 0.183.2. Identical 16:9 camera and explicit quality controls. No adapter, rack, UI, search or prewarm. State convergence skips composer.render, then three real endpoint frames per case. Software renderer times are diagnostic only, not hardware FPS. Assets served from the corresponding repository. Fresh browser context per repository.
assertions: Passed identical camera, selected cell, model pose, drawing buffer and quality; all three rendered frames have stable draw counts; no browser errors.
